svg.title: Stack — build, serve, ship
svg.desc: Build: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Zustand, TanStack Query, GSAP, Framer Motion. Serve: Node.js, Express, Laravel, PHP, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Supabase, Stripe. Ship: Flutter, Dart, Riverpod, Firebase, Jest, Playwright, Git, Vercel.
